group.label: NovaPay
group.comment: The exact postback URL for the scope being edited is shown in the read-only Postback URL field below. It is sent automatically as callback_url; register the same value in your NovaPay merchant admin panel.

field.label: Test Mode
field.comment: Switches the API base URL and payment frame URL between the qecom (test) and ecom (production) environments.

field.label: Private Key
field.comment: Your merchant RSA private key, used to sign outgoing requests. Stored encrypted; never displayed or logged in full — shown as "******" once saved. To change it, clear the field and paste the full new key (including the BEGIN/END lines); leaving "******" unchanged and saving keeps the existing key.

field.label: Public Key
field.comment: NovaPay's RSA public key, used to verify postback signatures.

field.label: Postback URL
field.comment: Register this URL as the postback (callback) URL in your NovaPay merchant panel. It is also sent automatically as callback_url with every payment session.

field.label: Payment Type
field.comment: Direct captures funds immediately. Hold blocks funds; capture is confirmed later from the order (within 29 days).

field.label: NovaPay refund button in order view
field.comment: When enabled, orders paid with NovaPay show a single "NovaPay Refund" button in the order view, and these native buttons are hidden: Credit Memo (order view and invoice view), Void (order view) and Refund Offline (credit memo form). For a hold the button cancels the order (the hold is released at NovaPay); for a paid order it opens a refund form and creates the standard online credit memo internally. When disabled, the native Magento credit memo flow is used.

field.label: NovaPay hold confirmation button in order view
field.comment: When enabled, a NovaPay order in hold shows a "Confirm NovaPay Hold" button in the order view, and the standard Invoice button is hidden for NovaPay orders. The button opens a form with the hold amount; a smaller amount is a partial confirmation (requires the Recipient Identifier). The button creates the standard online invoice, which sends the hold confirmation to NovaPay. When disabled, the native Magento invoice flow is used.

field.label: Postback Version
field.comment: Must match the postback version configured on your NovaPay merchant admin account.

field.label: Success URL
field.comment: Optional. Leave empty to use the default Magento checkout success page.

field.label: Fail URL
field.comment: Optional. Leave empty to restore the quote and return to the cart with an error message.

field.label: Success Redirect Timeout (sec)
field.comment: Seconds after which NovaPay's result page redirects the customer to the Success URL automatically. 0 disables the automatic redirect (the customer clicks the button).

field.label: Recipient Identifier (ЄДРПОУ/ІПН)
field.comment: Optional. Used in the operations[] list of a partial complete-hold request.

field.label: Enable Logging
field.comment: Logs every API request/response and postback to var/log/novapay.log. Critical errors are always logged regardless of this setting. Card data is always masked.

field.label: Convert Phone to +380 Format
field.comment: Converts phone numbers entered as 0XXXXXXXXX or 380XXXXXXXXX (spaces, dashes and brackets ignored) to the +380XXXXXXXXX format required by NovaPay before sending the payment request. Keep enabled unless your store already stores all phones in +380 format.

field.label: Validate Phone Number (+380 mask)
field.comment: Before sending the customer to NovaPay, check the shipping and billing phone numbers against the Ukrainian +380 mask (+380XXXXXXXXX / 380XXXXXXXXX / 0XXXXXXXXX). Checks both shipping and billing phone numbers (shipping is skipped for virtual orders). On failure the customer is shown the message below; an invalid shipping phone returns them to the shipping step, an invalid billing phone keeps them on the payment step.

group.label: NovaPay Order Status Mapping
group.comment: Magento order status applied for each NovaPay session status. Each NovaPay status maps to a fixed Magento order state; only statuses valid for the fixed Magento state are listed. Transient statuses (processing_hold_completion, processing_void) are never mapped here — they cause no status change.

field.label: Created
field.comment: Set at order placement, before the customer reaches the payment frame.

field.label: Processing
field.comment: Customer is on the NovaPay payment frame.

field.label: Holded
field.comment: Hold mode: authorization transaction recorded.

field.label: Hold Confirmed
field.comment: Hold mode: capture confirmed, invoice marked paid.

field.label: Paid
field.comment: Direct mode: payment captured, paid invoice auto-created.

field.label: Failed
field.comment: Order stays pending payment, stock stays reserved: the customer can retry in the same NovaPay session.

field.label: Voided (session fully refunded)
field.comment: Credit memo completes / hold canceled. Partial void postbacks never change order status.

field.label: Expired
field.comment: Unpaid session or uncaptured hold expired after 29 days; pending order canceled.
